attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: cms_article_publication
steps:
  - id: fetch_csrf_token
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/session/token"
      method: GET
    output: raw_csrf_token

  - id: extract_csrf_token
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: raw_csrf_token
      field: "csrf_token"
    output: csrf_token

  - id: authenticate_publisher
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "publisher"
    output: auth_result

  - id: validate_article_payload
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: article_payload
      schema: cms_article_schema
    output: validated_article

  - id: extract_content_sections
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_article
      field: "content_sections"
    output: content_sections

  - id: loop_content_sections
    op: loop_records
    params:
      input: content_sections
      steps:
        - id: transform_section_to_paragraph
          op: transform_json
          params:
            input: "$$current_item"
            mapping:
              type: "paragraph--content_block"
              attributes:
                field_body:
                  value: "$$current_item.html"
                  format: "full_html"
          output: paragraph_payload

        - id: create_paragraph_block
          op: call_webhook
          params:
            input: paragraph_payload
            url: "/jsonapi/paragraph/content_block"
            method: POST
            headers:
              Content-Type: "application/vnd.api+json"
              X-CSRF-Token: "$$csrf_token"
          output: raw_paragraph_response

        - id: validate_paragraph_response
          op: validate_schema
          params:
            input: raw_paragraph_response
            schema: paragraph_response_schema
          output: validated_paragraph

        - id: extract_paragraph_uuid
          op: extract_field
          params:
            input: validated_paragraph
            field: "data.id"
          output: paragraph_uuid
    output: paragraph_uuids

  - id: transform_article_node_payload
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_article
      mapping:
        type: "node--article"
        attributes:
          title: "$$validated_article.title"
          field_metadata: "$$validated_article.metadata"
        relationships:
          field_content_blocks: "$$paragraph_uuids"
    output: article_node_payload

  - id: create_article_node
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: article_node_payload
      url: "/jsonapi/node/article"
      method: POST
      headers:
        Content-Type: "application/vnd.api+json"
        X-CSRF-Token: "$$csrf_token"
    output: raw_article_response

  - id: validate_article_node_response
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_article_response
      schema: article_node_response_schema
    output: validated_article_node

  - id: extract_node_id
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_article_node
      field: "data.id"
    output: article_node_id

  - id: extract_article_title
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_article_node
      field: "data.attributes.title"
    output: article_title

  - id: log_publication_audit
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: article_node_id
      entry:
        action: "article_published"
        article_title: "$$article_title"
        node_id: "$$article_node_id"
        timestamp: "$$NOW"
